$comment: Credit-pool health. Billing drives routing, so tiers are keyed on credit pools, not vendors. A pool listed with `dead_until` is skipped by src/lib/roster.mjs until that date passes; a binding matching no entry here is healthy. Matching is by the profile's runtime binding (provider + model prefix), so a new model on a dead pool is dead automatically. Record an outage here -- never by deleting the seat from roster/routing.json, which would lose its fallback chain.

opencode-go.reason: Example: subscription monthly usage cap hit. A capped agent may not error -- it can sit `running` forever with no pending permission.
